description: Urban Forestry Toolkit is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by U.S. Forest Service (USFS); American Forests; National Association of Regional Councils. Discover how healthy tree canopy can enrich your community. Take one step at a time, starting with an assessment of your current urban tree canopy. Each step you take will build on your previous work help you build a thriving urban forestry program. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Air Quality, Extreme Heat. Assets: Cultural and Community Services, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
